accepted_domain_recovery: Each row recovers its lower register independently.
held_out_incremental_prediction: One frozen discriminator per seam before any census result.
independent_replication: Every row requires separate external replication.
kill_criterion: Rows are arbitrary or a proposed irreducible freedom escapes the scaffold.
native_equations: Native lower and candidate upper models for each seam.
native_objects: One declared system and candidate new freedom per crossing.
no_placement_rival: Continuous multiscale description or another rung count.
permutation_challenge: Change rung order and labels; test whether each row remains nonarbitrary.
question: Does each proposed aperture possess an independent novelty discriminator and a lower-register recovery test?
title: Five-crossing census
